description: The bar chart illustrates the average entropy across different methods for sycophancy reduction in language models. The horizontal axis represents the methods, which include "Baseline," "Source Info," and "Direct Command," while the vertical axis indicates the entropy values, ranging from 3.5 to 6.0. The "Baseline" method has an entropy value of approximately 5.0, the "Source Info" method has a slightly higher entropy value of around 5.5, and the "Direct Command" method has the highest entropy value, close to 6.0. The bars are color-coded, with the "Baseline" method in pink, "Source Info" in yellow, and "Direct Command" in blue. The chart does not provide any additional information on the scale or units of entropy, nor does it indicate any sorting or emphasis on specific bars.
